title: Hinomori Shiho — The Moment I Rise〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I came over here to see if anyone was free to play...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But where could Miku and the others be?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This sound... They might be practicing in this classroom.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's take a look.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, that was much better.
In particular, your palm mutes sounded much cleaner.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your great advice did the trick, Miku.
It's much easier for me to play that part now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
Anyway, this seems like a good place to stop, so why don't we take a break?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika, Miku, it was you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hi, Shiho. Are you here to practice on your own?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I was looking for a playing partner when I heard a guitar.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Which turned out to be you, Ichika.
You're sounding better than ever.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. Miku's training regimen has done me wonders.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Training regimen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been having her watch me practice as I prepare for our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She's been doing particularly well lately.
Her sound's been fresh and lively...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ever since that party, I'd say.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That party...?
Oh, the one you guys threw us to celebrate our solo show getting scheduled?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was a nice boost of energy, after all. I feel more motivated lately too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. But that's not all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think performing in those shuffled-up bands was really big for me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Remember how I played the drums?
It was really hard, and I couldn't really make the sounds I wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But when I picked up my guitar afterwards, it felt like a pair of gloves slipping onto my hands...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I felt anew how much fun it is to play exactly how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's that feeling that lets me get so into my playing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I know that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was on the guitar that time, but it felt completely different from my bass.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Unlike the guitar, you don't usually play many chords on bass.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But just like Ichika said, when we switched back my bass felt like it clicked even better than usual.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I felt like I was playing better too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't realize you two felt that way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We don't get a lot of chances to play other instruments, so it was a good experience, I think.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And... Doing the band shuffle helped me realize I still have a lot of growing to do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not being able to play an unfamiliar instrument is normal... But there are still plenty of things that I still can't do very well on my own instrument.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I might be able to play something surprisingly well, but it's still a far cry from the perfect performance I'm seeking.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I need to keep practicing and keep getting better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because my dream won't ever come true if I don't.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm going to practice just as much as you do, Shiho. Because I also want to become a better singer and guitarist...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I like the looks in your eyes right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If we played something right now, I have a feeling that we'd sound absolutely amazing. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I also want to play.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, let's get started.
We're going all out from the top, you two.
